entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H、R 两栏皆空，L「Corridor batauas」疑为 Corregidor 或本节起首之残文，M「Loh can cōy」无汉字可锚定。

entries.zh: 规正、规劝；按规矩矫正
entries.en: to set right by rule; to admonish, regulate

entries.zh: 改正、改过（「该」疑借作「改」）
entries.en: to amend, to correct (「該」 read for 改)
entries.notes: M「cáy」调类近「该」而远「改」，R「guīŏy」亦不契官话「该」，姑依 L「corregir」取改过义。

entries.zh: 压束、管束（「押」通「压」）；以压制纠正
entries.en: to press down, restrain; to discipline by restraint
entries.notes: 「押」当通「压」（同页第 10、11 条正作押煞、压杀），R「yā」两字同音无以为别。

entries.zh: 断案、判定是非（断而正之）
entries.en: to judge, to adjudicate (settle a matter)

entries.zh: 督责、督察；以上司之权纠正
entries.en: to supervise and reprove; to correct by authority
entries.notes: L「cōs」为 con / a los 之缩写；M 栏 Fôg 疑为 Tôg（tok），与「督」合。

entries.zh: 依刑书（律书）纠正、按律责治
entries.en: to correct according to the penal statutes; to chastise by the law books
entries.notes: M「Lán hiâg」、R「săn」均与「刑」音不密合，义就 L「cōs libros」与「刑书」推，H 栏或另有误录。

entries.zh: 示惩警众（惩一警百）；以警戒纠正
entries.en: to warn by exemplary punishment (escarmiento); to correct by warning

entries.zh: 儆戒、告诫使知所警惕
entries.en: to admonish and warn (so as to correct)

entries.zh: 押煞：镇压煞气、驱制邪祟
entries.en: to suppress baleful influence (apotropaic rite); to quell evil
entries.notes: 「押煞」为闽南驱邪制煞之俗语，故与 corregir 之「压伏」义相通，非寻常「改正」义。

entries.zh: 压杀：压伏摧折；引申为压制
entries.en: to crush, press down; to oppress (oprimir)
entries.notes: L 栏 agrimir 疑为 oprimir（压制），M「âb sât」正合「压杀」(ap-sat)。

entries.zh: 教张：教导而张布教令；以教示纠正
entries.en: to teach and lay out (rules); to correct by instruction
entries.notes: 「教张」搭配罕见、M 栏 gìo 带 T99 污损，义就 L「corregir」与「教」字推。

entries.zh: 惩戒、责罚以示儆
entries.en: to discipline, to punish (so as to correct)

entries.zh: 面拆：当面拆穿、面斥（使之无所遁饰）
entries.en: to expose and rebuke to one's face; to shame openly
entries.notes: L「al de lenguas」指通译，与「面拆」义不相接，疑 L 为旁记而误入词头；zh 依 H、M 定。

entries.zh: 箴规：规劝告诫
entries.en: to admonish and counsel; admonition (so as to correct)

entries.zh: 格言；以格言（道理）规正
entries.en: maxim, aphorism; to correct by reasoned precept
entries.notes: L 栏 racon 疑为 razón（以理），H 栏「格言」为名词性对译。

entries.zh: 警省：警戒而自省
entries.en: to warn and awaken (to self-reflection); to correct oneself

entries.zh: 行家法：以家规责治家中人
entries.en: to apply household discipline; to chastise one's own household
entries.notes: L「alos de Fu capa」疑为 a los de su casa（家中之人），正合「家法」。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 栏于跟/究/宪之间不能定，L「sin de simular」亦残，M、R 仅作 guīn guīn，无义可据。

entries.zh: 削改文字、削去误笔以正之
entries.en: to scrape out and emend errors in writing
entries.notes: 「刑削」于义未安，疑首字为删/刊之误录；「削」与 L「corregir la escritura」相合。

entries.zh: 诲戒：教诲而告诫
entries.en: to instruct and admonish

entries.zh: 雕琢（彫琢）：琢磨修饰，喻教导而纠正
entries.en: to carve and polish; (fig.) to refine by teaching, correct through instruction
